output.final_answer: As of 2025, Cairo is the most populous of the three cities, with an estimated population exceeding 23 million. Kinshasa and Lagos follow, with population estimates generally ranging between 17 million and 22 million depending on the metropolitan area definition used. Regarding growth, while all three cities are expanding, Kinshasa is most frequently identified as the fastest-growing among them, driven by high fertility rates and intense rural-to-urban migration in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Lagos also maintains a very high growth rate, while Cairo exhibits a relatively more moderate rate of expansion compared to the sub-Saharan megacities.
